title: Annihilation, Independence, and Residue: Sharp Matching Bounds for the Annihilation Gap and a TxGraffiti Application
summary: Let $G$ be a finite simple graph. The annihilation number $a(G)$ is an efficiently computable upper bound on the independence number $α(G)$. We develop a sharp matching-number theory for the gap $a(G)-α(G)$. The strongest general theorem is the exact closed form \[a(G)-α(G)\leq 2μ(G)+1- \lceil \sqrt{6 μ(G)} \rceil \qquad(μ(G)\geq 1), \] and the bound is attained for every prescribed matching number.
